exodus.15.p1.b1.text: Then Moses and the Israelites sang this song to the LORD:

exodus.15.p1.b2.text: I will sing to the LORD, for He is highly exalted. The horse and rider He has thrown into the sea.

exodus.15.p1.b3.text: The LORD is my strength and my song, and He has become my salvation.

exodus.15.p1.b4.text: He is my God, and I will praise Him, my father’s God, and I will exalt Him.

exodus.15.p1.b5.text: The LORD is a warrior, the LORD is His name.

exodus.15.p2.b6.text: Pharaoh’s chariots and army He has cast into the sea; the finest of his officers are drowned in the Red Sea.

exodus.15.p2.b7.text: The depths have covered them; they sank there like a stone.

exodus.15.p2.b8.text: At the blast of Your nostrils the waters piled up; like a wall the currents stood firm; the depths congealed in the heart of the sea.

exodus.15.p2.b9.text: I will pursue, I will overtake…I will draw my sword; my hand will destroy them.

exodus.15.p2.b10.text: But You blew with Your breath, and the sea covered them. They sank like lead in the mighty waters.

exodus.15.p3.b11.text: Who among the gods is like You, O LORD? Who is like You—majestic in holiness, revered with praises, performing wonders?

exodus.15.p3.b12.text: With loving devotion You will lead the people You have redeemed; with Your strength You will guide them to Your holy dwelling.

exodus.15.p3.b13.text: they will be as still as a stone until Your people pass by, O LORD, until the people You have bought pass by.

exodus.15.p3.b14.text: You will bring them in and plant them on the mountain of Your inheritance…

exodus.15.p3.b15.text: The LORD will reign forever and ever!”

exodus.15.p4.b16.text: For when Pharaoh’s horses, chariots, and horsemen went into the sea, the LORD brought the waters of the sea back over them. But the Israelites walked through the sea on dry ground.

exodus.15.p4.b17.text: Then Miriam the prophetess, Aaron’s sister, took a tambourine in her hand, and all the women followed her with tambourines and dancing.

exodus.15.p4.b18.text: Sing to the LORD, for He is highly exalted; the horse and rider He has thrown into the sea.

exodus.15.p5.b19.text: For three days they walked in the desert without finding water.

exodus.15.p5.b20.text: And when they came to Marah, they could not drink the water there because it was bitter. (That is why it was named Marah.)

exodus.15.p6.b22.text: And Moses cried out to the LORD, and the LORD showed him a log.

exodus.15.p6.b23.text: And when he cast it into the waters, they were sweetened.

exodus.15.p6.b24.text: If you will listen carefully to the voice of the LORD your God…then I will not bring on you any of the diseases I inflicted on the Egyptians. For I am the LORD who heals you.

exodus.15.p7.b25.text: Then they came to Elim, where there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees, and they camped there by the waters.
